items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: George Hooper played cornet... He used to be a plaster... I knew dude the trumpet player. You mean George Hooper? ... Oh no, he was a classer.

ctx.x: That was before he became a baritone player.
Yeah. George Simm, that's the baritone player. George Simm played baritone and George Hooper played cornet.
